about: Models of other authors that shells.py renders and this repository does not carry. tools/handheld-shells.ts downloads each GLB from Sketchfab (a token in SKETCHFAB_TOKEN or ~/.sketchfab-token) into dist/handheld-sources/<shell>.glb and checks its SHA-256.
